boards.title: Your First Weekend at Stockton University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key first-weekend sequence built around Stockton’s Galloway campus spaces, a lake walk, campus activities, and event planning.

cards.title: Start at the Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Galloway campus
cards.notes: Use the Campus Center as your orientation point: find the Information & Operations Desk, scan the building directory, and choose one next stop.
cards.short_summary: A central starting point for services, dining, lounges, and events.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton describes the Campus Center as a 154,000-square-foot gathering place with student services, dining, meeting, and entertainment options.
cards.access_notes: The Information & Operations Desk is listed in Suite CC-103; check campus operations for current building access.

cards.title: Pick a casual first meal
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Campus Center lower level
cards.notes: Meet up over a meal, then use the food court seating areas to compare weekend plans before heading to an activity or walk.
cards.short_summary: A large on-campus dining area with several food options and seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton’s Campus Center Food Court offers varied seating and dining options managed by Chartwells, including Chick-fil-A, Create, and other concepts.
cards.source_title: Dining and Retail - Campus Center | Stockton University
cards.access_notes: Food and dining availability vary; consult Stockton Dining for current hours and options.

cards.title: Pause at the Coffee House
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Campus Center main level
cards.notes: Stop by the Coffee House for a low-pressure meet-up, then check whether its small performance venue has a campus program scheduled.
cards.short_summary: A Campus Center gathering space beside the Game Room.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton identifies the Coffee House as a main-level Campus Center space that includes Dunkin’, sits next to the Game Room, and functions as a small performance venue.
cards.source_title: Game Room & Coffee House - Campus Center | Stockton University
cards.access_notes: Dunkin’ purchases are optional; confirm current dining hours before going.

cards.title: Play a round in the Game Room
cards.subtitle: Friday night · Campus Center main level
cards.notes: Bring your Stockton ID and borrow a board game or try ping pong, foosball, or billiards for an easy first-night group activity.
cards.short_summary: Free recreation with board games, billiards, ping pong, and foosball.
cards.evidence_claim: The Game Room provides billiards, ping pong, foosball, and board games free to the Stockton community with a Stockton ID.
cards.source_title: Game Room & Coffee House - Campus Center | Stockton University
cards.access_notes: Stockton lists academic-semester hours as daily, 10 a.m.–11:30 p.m.; hours change during breaks and it closes for summer.

cards.title: Walk the edge of Lake Fred
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Galloway campus
cards.notes: Take the paved route around the lake at a comfortable pace, pause at the outlet bridge, and stay on marked paths near the water.
cards.short_summary: Stockton’s central lake and a documented campus walking route.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton describes Lake Fred as the campus’s environmental centerpiece and outlines a 22-minute leisurely walk around it using campus paths and walkways.
cards.source_title: Three Places to Visit on Campus - Stockton Stories | Stockton University
cards.access_notes: Use marked paths and normal outdoor precautions; conditions and access can change with weather or campus operations.

cards.entity_name: Give a Book, Take a Book Lounge
cards.title: Browse the book-exchange lounge
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Coffee House area
cards.notes: Bring along a finished paperback if you have one, or simply browse the lounge’s exchange shelf while taking a quieter break from moving in.
cards.short_summary: A named book-exchange lounge in the Campus Center Coffee House area.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton lists the Give a Book, Take a Book Lounge within the Campus Center Coffee House and invites visitors to leave a book and take a new one.
cards.source_title: Game Room & Coffee House - Campus Center | Stockton University
cards.access_notes: Located in the Coffee House area; availability of exchange books may vary.

cards.title: Check the Campus Center Theatre
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Campus Center, CC-145
cards.notes: Locate the theatre while you are in the building, then look up the current program calendar to see whether a campus event fits your weekend.
cards.short_summary: A named Campus Center theatre and event space.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton’s Campus Center directory lists the Theatre at CC-145, and the University uses Campus Center spaces for programming and events.
cards.source_title: Building Directory - Campus Center | Stockton University
cards.access_notes: Event access and ticketing depend on the individual program; check the current listing before attending.

cards.title: Find the Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · L-Wing, Galloway campus
cards.notes: Add the gallery to your campus loop and check its exhibition calendar before visiting, so you can plan around the currently installed show.
cards.short_summary: Stockton’s named campus art gallery in L-Wing.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton’s Galloway campus map lists the Art Gallery in L-Wing, and the University has hosted public exhibitions there.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current exhibitions, hours, and entry details with the gallery before making a dedicated trip.

cards.title: Look ahead at the Performing Arts Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · Galloway campus
cards.notes: Check the Performing Arts Center calendar and box office details for a future performance, then save one event that works with your schedule.
cards.short_summary: Stockton’s on-campus performing-arts venue and box office.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton identifies the Stockton Performing Arts Center at 101 Vera King Farris Drive in Galloway and provides its box office contact.
cards.source_title: Contact Us - Performing Arts Center | Stockton University
cards.access_notes: Performance dates, ticket requirements, and accessibility arrangements vary by event; confirm them with the PAC box office.

cards.title: Choose one campus event to try
cards.subtitle: Sunday planning stop · online through OspreyHub
cards.notes: Open OspreyHub’s Events tab, filter for an interest you genuinely share, and add one upcoming educational, service, or social program.
cards.short_summary: Stockton’s student-involvement platform for organizations and event discovery.
cards.evidence_claim: Stockton identifies OspreyHub as its web-based student-involvement platform and directs students to its Events tab to find programs.
cards.access_notes: Log in with Stockton credentials; individual events may have registration, attendance, or cost requirements.

warnings: Bjork Library is renovating and scheduled to reopen in fall 2026, so it was intentionally omitted from this weekend sequence.
